C-64.Name: Site refresh: mark.xronocode.com in the ¶ paper/ink/marker brand, mobile-first, with a Mac install bar on iPhone, Avenex-grade SEO/consent/CSP and one visual language across landing, docs and gallery
C-64.Supersedes: C-35 S1–S3 and the docs-restyle part of S4 (C-35 stays a draft for the 10-language site and the hosting move, which this change does not do).
C-64.Summary: The site looks like a stock VitePress document beside a hand-built landing in the old type (Schibsted Grotesk + JetBrains Mono, oklch accent). Rebuild it in the brand the icon and the App Store frames set (paper #F5EFE4, ink #17191E, marker #FFCF1A, no blue; Bricolage Grotesque + IBM Plex, the proof-sheet language the /diagrams/ gallery already uses), phone first: the iPhone first screen shows the product and a "Mark for Mac" bar instead of a cookie banner over the hero. The landing, a custom VitePress theme for the docs, the gallery and the changelog share one token set, light and dark, without a theme flash. The SEO/consent/security set from the Avenex site is carried over (canonical, OG image, JSON-LD, sitemap, llms.txt, security.txt, CSP by hashes, Consent Mode v2 with a geo gate, GA4 download_click). Deploy through the existing site.yml to GitHub Pages after the user's OK.

Problem.Description: On a phone the landing is about ten screens long and the cookie banner covers the hero; Mark is a Mac app but an iPhone visitor gets no way to send it to their Mac; docs use the default VitePress look (blue accent, Inter) so landing, docs and gallery read as three sites; the head lacks JSON-LD, llms.txt, security.txt and a CSP; downloads are not measured as an event.

Goals.R-1: Brand tokens: one token file (site/shared/brand.css or equivalent) with paper/ink/marker + derived mute/rule/chip for light and dark, the type scale and the three self-hosted font families (Bricolage Grotesque 800, IBM Plex Sans 400/500/600, IBM Plex Mono 500; woff2 subsets, preload of the two used above the fold). Schibsted Grotesk and JetBrains Mono leave the site. The gallery switches from its near-miss palette (#F2EDE3/#131418/#FFD21F) to these tokens.
Goals.R-2: No theme flash: an inline head script sets data-theme from the saved choice or prefers-color-scheme before first paint on every page (landing, docs, gallery); one toggle, the choice shared across the three via the same storage key (VitePress's own key reused so docs and landing agree).
Goals.R-3: Landing rebuilt mobile-first in the approved direction (D-9; prototype in design/d3.html, artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/9YTHAf5DERFeS6pBUz66UM v3): ¶-numbered sections (agents/live reload, diagrams → /diagrams/, themes, footprint, editions/install, footer), facts verified against README/CHANGELOG/repo (v2.5.0, App Store 2.1.17 → next 2.5.0, 32 diagram types, 32 themes, install commands); at 390 px the page is at most ~5 screens; breakpoints 980/520, dvh and safe-area insets; no horizontal scroll at 320/390/1440 and landscape.
Goals.R-4: Install paths: Mac App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6814590464), Homebrew (`brew tap xronocode/mark && brew install --cask mark`, copy button), Windows x64 setup.exe from GitHub Releases with the SmartScreen note; the "Two editions" table facts match site/guide/editions.md and README. Mark Text wording: "inspired by" / "a different technical take", never "successor" or "abandoned"; no competitor names.
Goals.R-5: iPhone/iPad bar: on iOS/iPadOS (incl. iPadOS reporting a Mac UA with touch) a sticky top bar "Mark for Mac" is visible on first paint, with "Send to Mac" (Web Share API: title + URL → AirDrop/Messages/Notes) falling back to "Copy link", and a dismiss that is remembered. On macOS Safari the native <meta name="apple-itunes-app" content="app-id=6814590464"> banner. Desktop browsers see neither.
Goals.R-6: Consent never covers the hero: a slim bottom card that appears only after the visitor scrolls past the hero (or after a delay on short pages), shown only where consent is required (geo gate), with Consent Mode v2 defaults denied before any tag loads; GA4 and the Cloudflare beacon keep using the GA_MEASUREMENT_ID / CF_BEACON_TOKEN repo vars.
Goals.R-7: Analytics: GA4 event download_click {method: app_store|homebrew_copy|windows|github, placement: hero|install|bar|footer|docs} on every install link/copy, plus share_to_mac {result: shared|copied|dismissed} from the iPhone bar. No event fires without consent.
Goals.R-8: SEO set: per-page canonical, OG/Twitter image (a 1200×630 brand card committed under site/public, regenerated by a script), JSON-LD SoftwareApplication (name, operatingSystem macOS/Windows, applicationCategory, offers price 0, downloadUrl, softwareVersion from one source), sitemap including diagrams/, robots.txt, llms.txt (what Mark is, install, docs map), /.well-known/security.txt (contact + expiry), hreflang x-default/en only (single language). Lighthouse mobile ≥ 95 SEO and accessibility on / and /diagrams/.
Goals.R-9: Security headers on GitHub Pages: a <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> on the landing and gallery with sha256 hashes of every inline script/style computed at build (no 'unsafe-inline' for scripts), script/connect hosts limited to GA4 and the Cloudflare beacon; referrer policy meta. Docs pages get the same meta where VitePress allows (inline hydration script hashed) or are documented as an exception.
Goals.R-10: Docs theme: site/.vitepress/theme/ extends the default theme with the brand tokens (--vp-c-brand-*, fonts, code blocks, tables, custom containers), a nav that fits 390 px without overflow (no +1 px trap), the landing's header/footer feel, and the Editions page cards (catch-up track 2.1.17 → 2.5.0) restyled from the tokens without breaking tests/renderer/editions-doc.test.js.
Goals.R-11: Checks: site npm run check extended (fonts/tokens present, no Schibsted/JetBrains, CSP hashes match the built inline code, JSON-LD parses, llms.txt + security.txt exist, apple-itunes-app on the landing, download_click wired on every install link); tests/site cover the new pure helpers; a Playwright screenshot matrix 320/390/1440 + 844×390 landscape × light/dark for /, /guide/, /guide/editions, /diagrams/ asserting scrollWidth ≤ innerWidth and the consent card not intersecting the hero.

Decisions.D-1: Hosting stays GitHub Pages (no HTTP headers): CSP and referrer policy go in meta tags; frame-ancestors cannot be set by meta and is out of scope. A Cloudflare move remains C-35 S5.
Decisions.D-2: Docs keep VitePress (search, sidebar, editLink) with a theme that extends DefaultTheme; no rewrite of docs to hand-built HTML.
Decisions.D-3: Tokens follow the icon (assets/icon) exactly; the App Store canvas and gallery near-miss values are migrated, not kept.
Decisions.D-4: Geo gate: keep the existing mechanism (consent.js already calls https://avenex.xronocode.com/api/geo, a Worker answering {consent} from request.cf.country with CORS for *.xronocode.com; time-zone fallback when the fetch fails). Only the banner placement and timing change; outside the gate analytics auto-grant as today.
Decisions.D-7: download_click is a new event (Avenex never implemented it; the digest only queries it): name and params as R-7.
Decisions.D-9: Hero (user decision 2026-10-18, round 2): direction 03 "Before / after" — headline "Agents write Markdown. Mark draws it." over a draggable before/after stage (raw Markdown the agent saved ↔ Mark's rendered page with real Pele SVGs), one sweep on load; under it the four-fact strip from direction 01 (live reload, ⌘D, 32 diagram types, native 0.4 s); the diagram wall of direction 02 becomes section ¶ 02 Diagrams (theme chips recolour live, swipe cards on phones, link to /diagrams/). On iOS the App Store button becomes "Send Mark to your Mac" (Web Share, copy fallback). Prototypes: design/d1.html, d2.html, d3.html + base.css/boot.js/data.js in this change folder. Round 1 (screenshot-based heroes) was rejected: weak slogan, screenshots not hero-grade, poor phone layout.
Decisions.D-8: Stale facts are fixed site-wide, not only on the landing: "v2.1 beta" fallback, "11 MB" / "11.7 MB" (re-measure the 2.5.0 DMG or drop the number), "21 themes" in site/index.md and site/guide/index.md, SITE_META.description.
Decisions.D-10: Old logo sweep (user request 2026-10-18): every remaining copy of the pre-C-33 blue "M" mark is replaced with the ¶ icon from assets/icon — the in-app brand image src/renderer/src/assets/images/logo.png (Recent screen, About), the legacy static/ icon set, and the README 07-home shot (re-captured by tests/e2e/readme-shots.spec.ts); unused site/public showcase PNGs, the 07-home site shot and the Schibsted/JetBrains fonts are deleted. The app change ships with the next app release; no tag here.
Decisions.D-5: English only, as today; one language keeps hreflang trivial.
Decisions.D-6: Implementation is delegated to ZCode agents per task in their own worktrees (no shell, --mode edit); the orchestrator runs builds, tests, screenshots, review, merge and deploy.

Constraints.Item: Do not break: tests/renderer/site/landing.test.js, site check-dist (gallery 32 SVGs, links, hosts), tests/site, tests/renderer/editions-doc.test.js, /diagrams/ links, the App Store catch-up section on Editions.
No new runtime dependency on the site; dev tooling only if needed for font subsetting or the OG card (prefer Playwright already in the repo).
Every number fact-checked against README.md / CHANGELOG.md / repo; no invented stats.
Deploy only after the user's OK: commit, git push fork main, watch the site workflow, verify prod with curl + Playwright. No app release tag.

NonGoals.Item: Localising the site (C-35 S4 languages) and moving hosting (C-35 S5).
Changing app code, What's New or store listings.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1..R-11 done; `cd site && npm ci && npx vitepress build . && node scripts/check-dist.mjs` green; `npx vitest run tests/site tests/renderer/editions-doc.test.js` green; `grace lint --path . --assertions current` = 0 errors; screenshot matrix shown to the user with zero horizontal overflow; prod mark.xronocode.com serves the new site and passes the same checks after the site workflow.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: cd site && npm ci && npx vitepress build . && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Screenshot matrix (4 pages × 4 viewports × 2 themes), overflow report, Lighthouse mobile scores, CSP hash check output, prod curl of head tags.
